info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Promotional Events API
info.description: The Promotional Events API allows users to access and retrieve information about marketing promotional events related to banking services. This API provides vital details about current and upcoming events, enabling marketing teams, customer service representatives, and business analysts to make informed decisions and enhance customer engagement strategies. The typical consumers include marketing departments seeking to understand promotional activities and customers looking to capitalize on special offers. Through this API, stakeholders can efficiently monitor promotional initiatives and assess their effectiveness in driving customer interaction.

get.description: Fetch a list of promotional events for marketing strategies and campaigns. This endpoint allows you to obtain all currently active promotional events, which can be used to optimize marketing efforts and enhance customer engagement.

requestBody.description: This request body is required to fetch promotional events. It must conform to the specified JSON schema which outlines the necessary parameters and structure.
